tasks.command: set -eu; export UV_LOCK_TIMEOUT=900; SECONDS=0; ROOT="{work_dir}"; PROJECT="$ROOT/projects/cnn_smoke"; ENV="$ROOT/envs/cnn_smoke"; mkdir -p "$ROOT/tools" "$ROOT/python" "$ROOT/cache/uv" "$ROOT/tmp" "$ROOT/config" "$PROJECT" "$ENV" "$ROOT/runs"; UV="$ROOT/tools/uv"; if [ ! -x "$UV" ] || ! "$UV" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^uv 0\.12\.15([[:space:]]|$)'; then curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 3 --silent --show-error https://astral.sh/uv/0.12.15/install.sh -o "$ROOT/tmp/uv-install.sh"; printf '%s  %s\n' '716a1d6844740756c68770fcec2f79c2013fb9b03869a113f61e15f6f482a6a1' "$ROOT/tmp/uv-install.sh" | sha256sum -c -; UV_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp" sh "$ROOT/tmp/uv-install.sh" --no-modify-path; fi; test -x "$UV"; "$UV" --version | grep -Eq '^uv 0\.12\.15([[:space:]]|$)'; UV_CACHE_DIR="$ROOT/cache/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/python" UV_TOOL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp" "$UV" python install --install-dir "$ROOT/python" --no-bin 3.10; UV_CACHE_DIR="$ROOT/cache/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/python" UV_TOOL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$ENV" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp" "$UV" sync --frozen --project "$PROJECT" --python 3.10; UV_CACHE_DIR="$ROOT/cache/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/python" UV_TOOL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$ENV" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp" "$UV" run --frozen --project "$PROJECT" --python 3.10 python -c 'import torch; assert torch.cuda.is_available(); print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, torch.cuda.get_device_name(0))'; printf 'OPENSMI_SETUP_ELAPSED_S=%s\n' "$SECONDS"

metadata.purpose: repair data-disk uv environment and validate CUDA torch

tasks.command: set -eu; ROOT="{work_dir}"; PROJECT="$ROOT/projects/cnn_smoke"; ENV="$ROOT/envs/cnn_smoke"; export UV_CACHE_DIR="$ROOT/cache/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/python" UV_TOOL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$ENV" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp"; cd "$PROJECT"; "$ROOT/tools/uv" run --frozen --project "$PROJECT" --python 3.10 python train.py --rank {rank} --world-size {world_size} --steps 20 --batch-size 64 --output "$ROOT/runs/cnn-{node_alias}.jsonl"
tasks.environment_check: set -eu; ROOT="{work_dir}"; PROJECT="$ROOT/projects/cnn_smoke"; ENV="$ROOT/envs/cnn_smoke"; UV="$ROOT/tools/uv"; test -x "$UV"; "$UV" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^uv 0\.12\.15([[:space:]]|$)'; test -x "$ENV/bin/python"; test -f "$PROJECT/uv.lock"; UV_CACHE_DIR="$ROOT/cache/uv" UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR="$ROOT/python" UV_TOOL_DIR="$ROOT/tools" UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$ENV" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$ROOT/config" TMPDIR="$ROOT/tmp" "$UV" run --frozen --project "$PROJECT" --python 3.10 python -c 'import torch; assert torch.cuda.is_available()' >/dev/null
